journey.name: Welcome and the first week
journey.description: A fresh install opens on the welcome, once: what the app is, then a page each for Today, Train and Log, then Set up. From then Today carries a First week card (build the week, do the first workout, follow a flow, and with a sport planned log a day of it), each ticked as it is done, until it is hidden. Someone who had the app before never sees either. Run on a fresh install (adb shell pm clear dev.justinsmith.interval), on a Thursday or with the day below moved to suit.

actions.action: Open the app and verify that, after the intro, it shows the mark over "Interval", "Strength, conditioning and mobility, in one week.", "Three pages, then four questions.", a "Get started" button and "Skip to Set up", with nothing under the status bar or the gesture bar

Tap "Get started" and verify a page headed by the Today tab's icon on the accent beside "Today", titled "Today picks for you", with an example "Up next" card and the minutes 5 to 30, three marks at the top with the first lit, Back and "Skip"
Tap the example's "Start" and a minute, and verify that nothing happens
Tap "Next" and verify "Three ways to train" under "Train", with Strength, Conditioning and Mobility each over a line of what it holds, and the second mark lit
Swipe back (or press Back) and verify that "Today picks for you" is shown again, not Today itself; tap "Next" twice

Verify "Everything counts toward the week" under "Log", with a week of dots, "BJJ" under two of them, and "Done", "Today" and "Planned" under the card; turn the phone and verify that the same page is still shown, then turn it back
Tap "Set up my week" and verify that "Set up" is shown; tap "Climbing", then T (Thursday), "12" and "20 min", and "Build my week"

Verify that Today is shown with "Week built", and under what is up next a card headed "First week · 1 of 4" beside "Hide": "Build the week" ticked and dimmed, then "Do the first workout" over "Start, above", "Follow a flow" over "Train · Mobility" with a chevron, and "Log Climbing" over "Here, on its day"
Tap "Log it" on the "Climbing" step of the day's card and verify that the card reads "First week · 2 of 4" with "Log Climbing" ticked
Tap "Follow a flow" and verify that Train opens on "Mobility"; start "Daily five", skip to its end, tap "Done", and go back to Today; verify "First week · 3 of 4"
Start what is up next, or a pick by time, end it after its first round and tap "Done"; verify that the card reads "First week · 4 of 4" with every row ticked and "Done" where "Hide" was
Tap "Done" on the card and verify that it goes; close the app from Recents, open it again and verify that it opens on Today with no welcome and no First week card

Clear the app, open it, tap "Skip to Set up" and then "Skip for now"; verify that Today shows "Nothing planned" and "First week · 0 of 3", with no row for a sport, and that "Build the week" opens "Set up"; go back, tap "Hide" and verify that the card goes
Clear the app, open it and swipe back on the welcome's first page; verify that Today is shown, and that opening the app again goes to Today
